episodes.title: An Incident at Creede
episodes.summary: When an injured outlaw shows up at her ranch, a headstrong widow sees that her life -- and the lives of those close to her -- will never be the same.

episodes.title: The Ladies of La Belle
episodes.summary: La Belle wrestles with an all-or-nothing offer. Bill seeks a dangerous way to prove himself, and Frank shares a story with a captive audience.

episodes.title: Wisdom of the Horse
episodes.summary: Bill envisions Roy's fateful stand, a reluctant Truckee learns to ride a horse, Whitey tries his hand at making music, and John spreads the word.

episodes.title: Fathers & Sons
episodes.summary: Bill receives some distressing news, and Frank takes on a different type of danger. A part of Alice's murky past comes into focus.

episodes.title: Shot the Head Off a Snake
episodes.summary: Eager to track Frank and his crew, Bill solicits help from the Army. Meanwhile, Alice and Roy hit pay dirt and Whitey shares a secret with Mary-Agnes.

episodes.title: Dear Roy...
episodes.summary: Mary-Agnes tries to help the free-spirited Martha escape her past. Grigg ensures Frank stays in the know. Roy struggles with his feelings for Alice.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: While the residents of La Belle prepare for Frank's onslaught, Whitey seeks help from an unexpected ally. Roy and Frank come to an understanding.
